data.question: What were the ten best powder days last season?
data.title: Ten best powder days, winter 2025-26
data.note: Highest powder scores of water year 2026, one bar per resort and day.
data.sql:
SELECT
  resort_name || ', ' || STRFTIME(date, '%b %-d') AS day,
  powder_score
FROM powder_score
WHERE
  water_year = 2026
ORDER BY
  powder_score DESC,
  resort_name
LIMIT 10

data.question: Is colder snow really lighter?
data.title: Storm-day snow density against air temperature
data.note: Each point is a resort day with at least 4 inches of new snow; density is percent water.
data.sql:
SELECT
  temp_avg_24h_f,
  density_24h_pct,
  resort_name,
  date
FROM resort_daily
WHERE
  new_snow_24h_in >= 4
  AND NOT density_24h_pct IS NULL
  AND NOT temp_avg_24h_f IS NULL
ORDER BY
  temp_avg_24h_f
LIMIT 5000

data.question: How did the snowpack build at Alta, Snowbird and Brighton over the winter?
data.title: Snow depth through winter 2025-26
data.note: Daily snow depth at the stations for three Cottonwood resorts, November through May.
data.sql:
SELECT
  date,
  resort_name,
  snow_depth_in
FROM resort_daily
WHERE
  resort_name IN ('Alta', 'Snowbird', 'Brighton')
  AND date BETWEEN CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-05-31' AS DATE)
ORDER BY
  date,
  resort_name
LIMIT 5000

data.question: Rank every resort for the February 19 storm.
data.title: The morning of February 19, 2026
data.note: Each resort's report for 19 February 2026, joined to its powder score.
data.sql:
SELECT
  s.rank,
  s.resort_name,
  d.new_snow_24h_in,
  d.new_snow_72h_in,
  d.density_72h_pct,
  d.temp_avg_24h_f,
  s.powder_score,
  s.tier
FROM powder_score AS s
JOIN resort_daily AS d
  ON s.resort_id = d.resort_id AND s.date = d.date
WHERE
  s.date = CAST('2026-02-19' AS DATE)
ORDER BY
  s.rank
LIMIT 5000

data.question: How much snow fell each month in the Cottonwood canyons?
data.title: Monthly snowfall in the Cottonwoods, winter 2025-26
data.note: New snow summed by month for the four Cottonwood resorts in water year 2026.
data.sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', d.date), '%b %Y') AS month,
  d.resort_name,
  ROUND(SUM(d.new_snow_24h_in), 1) AS snowfall_in
FROM resort_daily AS d
JOIN resorts AS r
  ON d.resort_id = r.resort_id
WHERE
  r.area LIKE '%Cottonwood%'
  AND d.water_year = 2026
  AND d.date BETWEEN CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-04-30' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', d.date),
  d.resort_name
ORDER BY
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', d.date),
  d.resort_name
LIMIT 5000

data.question: How many powder days did each resort have last season?
data.title: Powder days by resort, winter 2025-26
data.note: Days in water year 2026 with a powder score of 55 or more (tiers 'powder' and 'epic').
data.sql:
SELECT
  resort_name,
  COUNT(*) AS powder_days
FROM powder_score
WHERE
  water_year = 2026 AND powder_score >= 55
GROUP BY
  resort_name
ORDER BY
  powder_days DESC,
  resort_name
LIMIT 5000

data.question: Which resort got the most snow last season?
data.title: Season snowfall by resort, winter 2025-26
data.note: Total estimated new snow for water year 2026. Station estimates read lower than a resort's own stake.
data.sql:
SELECT
  resort_name,
  MAX(season_snowfall_in) AS season_snowfall_in
FROM resort_daily
WHERE
  water_year = 2026
GROUP BY
  resort_name
ORDER BY
  season_snowfall_in DESC,
  resort_name
LIMIT 5000

data.question: Show the mid-February storm cycle at Snowbird day by day.
data.title: Snowbird, February 12 to 26, 2026
data.note: New snow in the 24 hours before each morning's reading at the Snowbird station.
data.sql:
SELECT
  date,
  new_snow_24h_in,
  snow_depth_in,
  density_24h_pct
FROM resort_daily
WHERE
  resort_name = 'Snowbird'
  AND date BETWEEN CAST('2026-02-12' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-02-26' AS DATE)
ORDER BY
  date
LIMIT 5000
